final_candidates.decision_summary: H13L in the N-terminal activation domain enhances Tat transactivation efficiency and Cyclin T1 interaction stability.
K28R maintains positive charge essential for P-TEFb interaction while preventing post-translational modifications that decrease transactivation.
S46A prevents inhibitory phosphorylation in the core domain, stabilizing Tat-mediated LTR transactivation.

stop_reason.detail: Candidate pool ranking has converged and no external tools are available in S0-iter control.

history.rationale: The H13L substitution in the N-terminal region is a functional variant associated with increased Tat transactivation activity and viral replication.
H13L in the N-terminal activation domain enhances transactivation efficiency and Cyclin T1 interaction stability.
S46 in the core domain is targeted by host inhibitory phosphorylation; mutating it to alanine prevents inactivation and enhances transactivation efficiency.
S46A prevents inhibitory phosphorylation in the core domain, stabilizing Tat-mediated LTR transactivation.
K28R maintains positive charge in the cysteine-rich domain while preventing PCAF-mediated acetylation, increasing CycT1 binding and transactivation.
K28R maintains positive charge essential for P-TEFb interaction while preventing post-translational modifications that decrease transactivation.
K50R preserves basic charge in the RNA-binding ARM domain while preventing acetylation that promotes TAR RNA dissociation, maintaining active transcription.
K50R preserves RNA-binding capacity in the ARM domain while preventing prematurely induced dissociation from TAR.
K41 in the hydrophobic core is essential for structural stability; the K41R conservative mutation retains positive charge and promotes transactivation.
K41R in the core region preserves positive charge and promotes core structure stability required for transactivation.
S16A eliminates inhibitory N-terminal phosphorylation, boosting Tat-mediated transactivation activity.
S16A prevents Ser16 phosphorylation, maintaining the active N-terminal baseline conformation.
A58T is a well-characterized natural polymorphism at the ARM/glutamine-rich boundary that correlates with enhanced transactivation kinetics.
A58T introduces a polar residue adjacent to the ARM domain that can enhance local conformational adaptability.
K71R stabilizes the C-terminal flexible region while maintaining basicity, enhancing overall Tat stability and transactivation potency.
K71R maintains positive charge in the Gln-rich region to preserve cellular protein-protein interactions.
